source_urls: https://www.airflofishing.com/products/<handle> (spec tables in product descriptions; taper diagrams in product images)
how_the_lineup_is_organized: Airflo (Wales, UK) makes PVC-free polyurethane lines, and its single-hand range is built from a small set of named tapers sold in several coating tiers. The current flagship tier is Superflo Max Ridge 2.0 (US $129.99-149.99). It pairs the raised-ridge Ridge 2.0 surface, which Airflo says cuts guide friction and tangles for more line speed, with the new 'Superflo Max Hybrid' coating for faster shooting and less memory. Superflo Max Smooth (US $99.99) uses the same taper names with a smooth finish at a lower price. In both tiers the taper name tells you the job. Universal is the all-rounder (39 ft head on a WF5), Power is shorter and heavier for big flies and rigs on fast rods, and Tactical is the delicate presentation taper. Super Trout is a 70 ft long-belly line, Nymph Indicator is for indicator rigs, and Streamer Float / Streamer Max are for streamers. Flats Universal, Tactical and Power, plus Redfish and GT, are the saltwater set. Ultra Supple versions use a cold-weather coating meant for fishing below about 50°F. Outside those tiers, Sixth Sense 2 is a stillwater family: long front tapers for teams of flies, with intermediates, Di3-Di8 sinkers and a 'Sweep' line. The 40+ lines (Extreme 36 ft head, Expert 44 ft, Booby Basher, Sniper) are integrated shooting-head distance lines for reservoirs and predators. Cast (2025, about $60) is the budget series. Each generation replaces the last: the original smooth Superflo, then Superflo Ridge 2.0 (e.g. Superflo Ridge 2.0 Universal Taper), now Superflo Max. The older versions are marked discontinued here, and their published tapers and grain weights mostly carry over unchanged. Buyers should pick the taper for the job first, then choose Ridge or Smooth by budget. That the tapers are identical across tiers is our inference from matching spec tables, not an Airflo claim. Prices are US list prices from Airflo's US distributor (Mayfly Outdoors); airflofishing.com itself prices in GBP.
